lead: Hollywood plumbing deals with king tides, heavy rain, 1920s homes and aging cast-iron drains. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers across Hollywood.
risk: cast-iron drain failures, tidal and storm flooding and slab leaks
risk_short: old drains, flooding and slab leaks
why: Hollywood Lakes and Downtown have homes from the 1920s to the 1950s, and much of the city was built before 1975. Cast-iron drains under those slabs rot from the inside.
King tides and heavy rain push water up through storm drains near the Intracoastal. Beach condos share risers and stacks.
water: Hollywood treats groundwater from the Biscayne and Floridan aquifers, using membrane treatment. It is moderately hard.
tips: Have cast-iron drains scoped in older homes.
Know king tide dates and your flood zone.
Shut off the main valve before a hurricane evacuation.
Check condo rules before plumbing work.
areas: PipeMend works in Hollywood Lakes, Downtown Hollywood, Hollywood Hills, Emerald Hills, Highland Gardens, Hollywood Beach and every other neighborhood.
permits: Plumbing permits come from the City of Hollywood Building Division, and plumbing contractors are licensed by the Florida Construction Industry Licensing Board.

faq.q: Is this Hollywood, Florida or Hollywood, California?
faq.a: This page covers the city of Hollywood, Florida, between Fort Lauderdale and Miami. For Hollywood in Los Angeles, see our Los Angeles page.
